headline: US Scrambles Over Tech Outages as Investors Target Cybersecurity Stocks
summary: The Trump administration and Congress are addressing nationwide technology failures, driving renewed investor inflows into cybersecurity equities.
why: Widespread system disruptions increase federal regulatory scrutiny and drive institutional allocations toward enterprise cybersecurity vendors.

impacts.name: Cybersecurity Software
impacts.why: High-profile system outages stimulate demand for protective cybersecurity platforms and investor capital inflows.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A wave of nationwide technology failures prompted investors to re-enter cybersecurity equities amid expectations of elevated enterprise and government protection spending.
